conclusion: The draft's single observation is internally consistent with the artifact: for seed 7, mse, linear=10.155670419036328 vs baseline=23.951894598705938, so OLS (linear) is lower than the matched training-mean baseline under 10% test-label outliers of magnitude 10 with clean training data. The draft is appropriately scoped as preliminary and makes no general claim. However, the evidence base is thin: only one seed (7) and one metric (mse) are present, so no variance, robustness, or metric-agnostic conclusion can be drawn. The draft's limitations correctly disclose this. The main methodological weakness is the absence of seeds 19 and 31 and of mae/median_absolute_error, which would be needed to assess stability of the observed gap.
limitations: Only seed 7 is present in evidence-1; seeds 19 and 31 were not executed, so no across-seed variance or robustness can be assessed.
Only mse was computed; mae and median_absolute_error were not executed, so the direction of the linear-vs-baseline gap is not established across metrics.
Single-seed, single-metric comparison; no confidence interval or significance assessment is possible.
No independent verification was executed in this review; verification_refs is empty.
The outlier magnitude (10) and clean-training-data setup are fixed; no sensitivity to these parameters is available.
